sources.supports: Chongqing-Shanghai ordinary water 11-12 days; express water 8-9 days; more than 3000 sailings and 718000 TEU by June 2022.
Downstream average 11 days; upstream average 15.8 days; 5523 sailings and 1.3908 million TEU.
A Minsheng Shipping operations manager reported comparative Chongqing-Shanghai 20-foot container costs: road CNY 15000, rail CNY 4600 and water CNY 1400; exact inclusions were not stated.
Historical Yangpu-Tuanjiecun five-fixed train: 55-60 hours, one train per week at launch and 40-48 containers per train; not proof of a current Guoyuan-Luchaogang train.
The operator reports two Chongqing-Shanghai sailings per week in each direction, ten days running time, 700-800 TEU and 9600-11000 tonnes per week; exact terminals are not identified.

National ETS expansion covers power, steel, cement and aluminum, not direct freight-transport compliance.

Model distances used here: road 1695 km, rail 1733 km, water 2399 km. A previous analysis incorrectly used the rail-column maximum 1754 km (the Chongqing-Zhangjiagang row) for Shanghai; the explicit Chongqing-Shanghai row is 1733 km. These are project parameters, not government observations.
